clauses.label: Sec. 4.
clauses.text:
Sec. 4. Notwithstanding the rates of basic pay or salaries established 
by sections 1, 2, and 3 of this order, under section 5308 of title 5 of 
the United States Code no rate of basic pay or salary may be paid 
which is in excess of the rate now or hereafter provided for level V  of 
the Executive Schedule.
Conversion Rules

clauses.label: Sec. 5.
clauses.text:
Sec. 5. The agencies hereinafter designated shall prescribe such rules 
as may be necessary to convert the rates of basic pay or salaries of 
officers and employees to the rates prescribed in this order:
(1 ) General Schedule, the Civil Service Commission;
(2 ) Schedules for the Department of Medicine and Surgery of the 
Veterans’ Administration, the Veterans’ Administration;
(3 ) Foreign Service schedules, the Department of State.
